description:
Sacrifice Tenacious Dead to Altar of Dementia, milling target opponent for 2.
Sifter of Skulls, Pitiless Plunderer, Blood Artist, and Tenacious Dead trigger; stack the triggers to resolve in that order.
Sifter of Skulls generates an Eldrazi Scion token; sacrifice it to float {1} (Pitiless Plunderer and Blood Artist trigger again).
Resolve two Pitiless Plunderer triggers, generating two Treasure tokens; crack one to float {B}.
Resolve two Blood Artist triggers, draining opponent for 2.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from the graveyard.
Repeat the sacrifice-recursion loop, gaining one Treasure token per loop and draining opponent infinitely with Blood Artist triggers.
